## Work

At Kinetichex, he leads full-stack development on client products: the
Sterling Forge casting portal, built end to end, and features across the
LawReach compliance platform. AI features ship inside these apps.

At Bizdesire, he led a 5-engineer team on Uplevelit and built Penbook and
Rocket Rebates solo.
His responsibilities included client requirements, estimates, web and mobile
coordination, code reviews and delivery.

Earlier roles: Associate React & Node.js Developer at Appcore Labs
(Oct 2022 - Dec 2023); Frontend Developer (React) at Fyntune Solutions
(Oct 2021 - Sept 2022).

## Case studies

- Sterling Forge: https://abhithakur.dev/work/sterling-forge
  Customer portal for a jewellery casting house, built at Kinetichex with one
  other engineer (Jul - Sep 2026). Instant quotes from uploaded CAD files at
  the live metal spot price, a Python mesh analyser on Modal, Stripe deposits
  and ACH with a nightly reconciliation job, and production stages that follow
  the order type. Fixed a 4% volume error in OpenCASCADE's default integrator
  that would have undercharged castings. Next.js, Postgres, Drizzle, Stripe.
- LawReach: https://abhithakur.dev/work/lawreach
  Legal and compliance workspace for Australian small businesses (Apr - Sep
  2026). Obligations catalogue grown from 17 to 85, statutory deadlines that
  never invent dates, postcode to council lookup, Claude document analysis
  with retrieval kept in the Sydney region, evidence bundles. Next.js,
  Supabase, pgvector, Stripe.
- Uplevelit: https://abhithakur.dev/work/uplevelit
  Experience marketplace at Bizdesire: 1:1 calls, group classes, live courses
  and Q&A on one booking model, Twilio Video, Stripe payments, refunds and
  operator payouts. Development team lead. React, Firebase Functions.
- Penbook: https://abhithakur.dev/work/penbook
  Writing, reading, posts and book clubs in one product, built solo at
  Bizdesire. NestJS, MongoDB, React, server-side OpenAI writing tools.
- Rocket Rebates: https://abhithakur.dev/work/rocket-rebates
  Rebate search, OpenAI reports and document checklists, S3 storage and an
  admin approval gate before filing, built solo at Bizdesire. NestJS,
  PostgreSQL on AWS RDS, full-text search.

## Stack

TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB,
Firebase, Stripe, OpenAI and Anthropic APIs. Recent Python work. Deployments
and delivery tooling include Docker, GCP, AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare,
GitHub Actions and Bitbucket Pipelines.
